Kramānyatvaṃ pariṇāmānyatve hetuḥ /III.15/
Krama-anyatvaṃ pariṇāma-anyatve hetuḥ /III.15/

« L'altérité dans la séquence est la cause de l'altérité dans la transformation. »

Ekasya dharmiṇa eka eva pariṇāma iti prasakte krama-anyatvaṃ pariṇāma-anyatve
hetur bhavati–iti /
Tad yathā-- cūrṇa-mṛt-piṇḍa-mṛd-ghaṭa-mṛt-kapāla-mṛt-kaṇa-mṛd iti ca kramaḥ / Yo yasya
dharmasya samanantaro dharmaḥ sa tasya kramaḥ / Piṇḍaḥ pracyavate ghaṭa upajāyata iti
dharma-pariṇāma-kramaḥ / Lakṣaṇa-pariṇāma-kramo ghaṭasya–anāgata-bhāvād vartamāna-
bhāvaḥ kramaḥ / Tathā piṇḍasya vartamāna-bhāvād atīta-bhāvaḥ kramaḥ / Na–atītasya–asti
kramaḥ / Kasmāt ? pūrva-paratāy
